title: Ballina
html_source: Ballina (/ˌbælᵻˈnɑː/; Irish: Béal an Átha, meaning “mouth of the ford”) is a town in north County Mayo, Ireland. It lies at the mouth of the River Moy near Killala Bay, in the Moy valley and Parish of Kilmoremoy
